ui.onboarding.intro.skip_hint.role: Small hint at the bottom of the intro
ui.onboarding.intro.skip_hint.note: Any key, click or scroll skips the intro.

ui.onboarding.intro.subtitle.role: Line under the welcome heading on the first-run intro: the product's tagline
ui.onboarding.intro.subtitle.note: Local Operator is a product name. 'Base of operations' is the user's headquarters / command centre for their agents, a figurative hub: never a military base or a database. Prefer the locale's natural 'operations centre' / 'hub' word.

ui.onboarding.intro.title.role: Welcome heading on the first-run intro, shown large under the brand mark
ui.onboarding.intro.title.note: Local Operator is the product name; keep it untranslated.

ui.onboarding.meet.done.role: Sentence under 'Meet Aida' when she has already greeted the user

ui.onboarding.meet.owed.role: Sentence under 'Meet Aida' while her first greeting is still owed
ui.onboarding.meet.owed.note: 'She' is the assistant (Aida). 'Chief of staff' is her role.

ui.onboarding.modal.title.meet.role: Heading of the last setup step and the name of its progress segment

placeholders.name: The assistant's display name, usually Aida

ui.onboarding.modal.title.search.role: Heading of the web search setup step and its progress segment name
ui.onboarding.modal.title.search.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.search.block.radient.role: Footer note on the search step while the Radient option is chosen but not signed in; Finish is disabled until then
ui.onboarding.search.block.radient.tone: Plain instruction naming both ways out
ui.onboarding.search.block.radient.note: 'Free' is the first option's own label (ui.onboarding.search.mode.free); use the same word. Radient stays untranslated.

ui.onboarding.search.mode.free_detail.role: Explanation of the preselected Free web-search option
ui.onboarding.search.mode.free_detail.note: Free search services are shared; no key needed; busy times can be slower. Deliberately names no vendors.

ui.onboarding.search.mode.not_needed.role: Muted detail replacing an option's description when Radient already provides search
ui.onboarding.search.mode.not_needed.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.search.mode.radient.role: Title of the middle web-search option: the Radient account, which the user can sign in to or create
ui.onboarding.search.mode.radient.tone: Neutral noun phrase; the button under it carries the verb
ui.onboarding.search.mode.radient.note: First-run setup stage. Radient is a product name; keep it untranslated.

ui.onboarding.search.mode.radient_action.role: Button in the middle web-search option that starts a Radient browser sign-in
ui.onboarding.search.mode.radient_action.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.search.mode.radient_detail.role: Explanation under the middle web-search option
ui.onboarding.search.mode.radient_detail.tone: Plain benefit list; says the account can be created here
ui.onboarding.search.mode.radient_detail.note: Radient is a product name; keep it untranslated.

ui.onboarding.search.mode.radient_done.role: Title of the middle option once Radient is connected
ui.onboarding.search.mode.radient_done.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.search.mode.radient_done_d.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.announce_connected.role: Screen-reader announcement when a sign-in completes

placeholders.brand: Provider or plan name, e.g. ChatGPT

ui.onboarding.signin.chatgpt.action.role: Button that starts a browser sign-in with a ChatGPT subscription
ui.onboarding.signin.chatgpt.action.note: A subscription log-in, not an API key.

ui.onboarding.signin.claude.action.role: Button that starts a browser sign-in with a Claude subscription
ui.onboarding.signin.claude.action.note: A subscription log-in, not an API key.

ui.onboarding.signin.connected.role: Trailing status on a connected account row
ui.onboarding.signin.connected.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.divider.role: Label in the middle of a horizontal divider above the ChatGPT and Claude buttons
ui.onboarding.signin.divider.note: These are subscription LOG-INS, not API keys. Never say 'API key' here.

ui.onboarding.signin.error.detail.role: Detail under the server-unreachable message on the sign-in step
ui.onboarding.signin.error.detail.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.error.retry.role: Button that retries reaching the local server
ui.onboarding.signin.error.retry.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.error.title.role: Message when the app's local server cannot be reached on the sign-in step
ui.onboarding.signin.error.title.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.more.role: Disclosure button that reveals API-key and local-model providers
ui.onboarding.signin.more.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.more_detail.role: Muted detail after 'Other ways to connect' on a disclosure button

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.action.role: Primary button that starts a Radient browser sign-in
ui.onboarding.signin.radient.action.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.action_add.role: Secondary button to add Radient after a subscription is connected
ui.onboarding.signin.radient.action_add.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.benefit.fal.role: Benefit list item in the Radient panel
ui.onboarding.signin.radient.benefit.fal.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.benefit.rou.role: Benefit list item in the Radient panel
ui.onboarding.signin.radient.benefit.rou.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.benefit.sea.role: Benefit list item in the Radient panel
ui.onboarding.signin.radient.benefit.sea.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.benefit.ski.role: Benefit list item in the Radient panel
ui.onboarding.signin.radient.benefit.ski.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.credit.role: Small print in the Radient panel
ui.onboarding.signin.radient.credit.note: Credit is conditional on eligibility; never imply an unconditional free offer or name an amount.

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.eyebrow.role: Small accent label above the Radient sign-in button
ui.onboarding.signin.radient.eyebrow.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.eyebrow_in_.role: Small label above the Radient panel once a ChatGPT or Claude plan is connected
ui.onboarding.signin.radient.eyebrow_in_.note: Means: we recommend adding Radient as well as the subscription already connected.

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.eyebrow_sig.role: Small label above the Radient panel once Radient is connected
ui.onboarding.signin.radient.eyebrow_sig.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.nudge.role: One sentence inside the Radient panel when only subscriptions are connected; the benefit list is hidden then

placeholders.brands: Connected subscription names joined by the locale's list format, e.g. 'ChatGPT and Claude'

ui.onboarding.signin.radient.nudge.note: Product names stay untranslated. No singular/plural 'plan': the sentence names the brands, not their plans.

ui.onboarding.signin.subscriptions_note.role: Small note under the ChatGPT and Claude buttons
ui.onboarding.signin.subscriptions_note.note: Plus, Pro, Max are plan names; keep them untranslated.

ui.onboarding.signin.subtitle.role: Sentence under the sign-in heading before anything is connected: why Radient, and that subscriptions can join
ui.onboarding.signin.subtitle.note: Radient, ChatGPT and Claude are product names; keep them untranslated. 'Plan' means the user's paid subscription.

ui.onboarding.signin.subtitle_connected.role: Sentence under the heading once a subscription (not Radient) is connected
ui.onboarding.signin.subtitle_connected.note: Repeats the connected state on purpose: the heading above it is now 'Your base of operations is ready'.

ui.onboarding.signin.subtitle_radient_co.role: Sentence under the heading once Radient is connected
ui.onboarding.signin.subtitle_radient_co.note: Radient, ChatGPT and Claude are product names; keep them untranslated. 'Plan' means the user's paid subscription. 'Powering' is figurative (Radient supplies the agents' models and tools), not electricity.

ui.onboarding.signin.title.role: Heading of the first setup step before anything is connected
ui.onboarding.signin.title.note: Echoes the intro tagline's 'base of operations'; use the same word for it. 'Base of operations' is the user's headquarters / command centre for their agents, a figurative hub: never a military base or a database. Prefer the locale's natural 'operations centre' / 'hub' word.

ui.onboarding.signin.title_connected.role: Heading of the first setup step once any account is connected
ui.onboarding.signin.title_connected.note: Same 'base of operations' word as the step's first heading. 'Base of operations' is the user's headquarters / command centre for their agents, a figurative hub: never a military base or a database. Prefer the locale's natural 'operations centre' / 'hub' word.

ui.onboarding.signin.waiting.role: Button label while a browser sign-in is waiting for the user
ui.onboarding.signin.waiting.note: First-run setup stage. Radient, ChatGPT, Claude and Local Operator are product names; keep them untranslated.
